verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document recognizing a previously verified person and reusing their prior passed check across sessions or products. The closest item, Known Faces, matches a face against earlier applicants to flag repeat identity fraud. That is an adjacent fraud-detection control, not reuse of a prior verification instead of a full re-run.

support.subject: As a developer, a person verified once can be recognized and reused across sessions or products — documented re-verification and reuse of a prior passed check instead of forcing a full re-run
